# Copilot instructions

This repository contains only the legacy Wat2Do React frontend.
Read `CLAUDE.md` before changing code.

Keep Wat2Do V2 as the only server and data source.
Do not recreate the deleted V1 backend, database, admin, Clerk, submission, newsletter, waitlist, promotion, or scraping paths.

Use the existing feature folders and shared API clients.
Keep API contracts aligned with Wat2Do V2.
Run `npm run lint` and `npm run build` from `frontend/` after changes.
